newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila PHIBOR rise, buck money market trend.
newsitem.headline: Manila PHIBOR rise, buck money market trend.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were slightly higher on Friday, bucking the downtrend in the money market, traders said.
"This is unusual," one dealer said, adding that there was no fundamental reason for PHIBOR rates to move up slightly.
He said banks probably just quoted wide bid and offer rates so they did not have to make any transactions since dealers are scheduled to go out of town for a convention this weekend.
"Most traders wanted to be out this morning," he said.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks are willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
